Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.updated: Last updated: March 2026. Have your legal team review before production use.
Privacy.p1: This Privacy Policy describes how Elevate (“we”, “us”) processes personal data when you use the Elevate platform and related services. It is provided for transparency and should be reviewed and adapted by your counsel to match your jurisdiction, product, and data flows.
Privacy.p2: We process personal data to provide authentication, event operations, analytics, customer support, and product improvement. Depending on context, lawful bases may include performance of a contract, legitimate interests balanced against your rights, or consent where required.
Privacy.p3: Categories of data may include account identifiers (such as email), profile and organization attributes, event and attendee records you choose to store, usage and diagnostic data, and communications with support. We do not sell personal data.
Privacy.p4: We use subprocessors for hosting, infrastructure, email delivery, and security operations. A current list is available on request under NDA for enterprise customers. International transfers may rely on appropriate safeguards such as Standard Contractual Clauses where applicable.
Privacy.p5: Retention depends on your plan and configuration. Enterprise agreements may specify retention, deletion, and export procedures. Where you are an authorized administrator, you may be able to manage certain records subject to role permissions.
Privacy.p6: Depending on your location, you may have rights to access, rectify, delete, restrict processing, object, or port data. Enterprise users should contact their account administrator first; others may contact us using the details in your order form or support channel.
Privacy.p7: Security measures are implemented in line with industry practice, including encryption in transit, access controls, and monitoring. No method of transmission or storage is completely secure; we continuously improve our program.
Privacy.p8: We may update this policy to reflect product or legal changes. Material changes will be communicated as required by law or your agreement. Continued use after the effective date constitutes acceptance where permitted.
Privacy.p9: For privacy requests or questions, contact your Elevate account team or the address provided in your enterprise agreement.

prompt-studio.metaDescription: Model-aware prompt improvement for teams that ship AI features. Pick a target model, analyze prompts, and get structured suggestions—scoped to your organization.
prompt-studio.title: Prompt Studio
prompt-studio.lead: Prompt Studio is Elevate's primary surface: model-aware prompt improvement for teams that ship AI features and internal copilots. Work is scoped to your organization—not a public playground—so drafts stay inside your tenant.
prompt-studio.section1Body:
Choose the model you deploy against, paste a prompt, and receive structured analysis and improvement suggestions. We focus on actionable output: what to change, why it matters, and how it aligns with model behavior—not generic tips.

Library and catalog run in parallel so your org can pair prompt work with entitlements and downloadable guides when operations attach files.
prompt-studio.section2Body:
Everything ties to your Elevate organization: members, roles, and billing. Prompt iterations stay auditable within the team, which matters when procurement asks how AI-assisted work is reviewed.

Studio access respects the same org boundaries as Library—no cross-tenant leakage by design.
prompt-studio.section3Body: Accept/reject flows, side-by-side diffs, and tighter integrations are on the roadmap. Join the waitlist to get Prompt Studio beta access first; production accounts remain the path for purchases and downloads.

ebooks-and-guides.metaDescription: Digital catalog and Library entitlements for guides and templates—purchased per org, downloaded when entitled.
ebooks-and-guides.title: E-books & guides
ebooks-and-guides.lead: The catalog is how we package high-signal guides and templates alongside Prompt Studio. Purchases grant your organization entitlements; Library surfaces what you can download when files are attached in operations.
ebooks-and-guides.section1Body:
Checkout (where enabled) records what your org has purchased or licensed. Library lists entitled titles so members know what they can download without hunting through email threads or shared drives.

If a title is locked, it is usually a subscription or entitlement issue—Billing is the right place to upgrade or unlock.
ebooks-and-guides.section2Title: Why we ship this in parallel
ebooks-and-guides.section2Body:
Prompt improvement is the hero loop; catalog and e-books are how we reward early believers and fund the roadmap without diluting the core product narrative.

Content is versioned in Git-friendly MDX for marketing and ops; digital products in Library follow the same org scoping as the rest of Elevate.
ebooks-and-guides.section3Body: Admins manage catalog rows in the platform console when configured. End users should always use Library for downloads so entitlements stay authoritative.

org-workspace.metaDescription: Organizations, roles, invitations, Library, and billing—single tenant for Prompt Studio and catalog entitlements.
org-workspace.title: Org workspace
org-workspace.lead: Elevate is organized around organizations: every member, invite, Library view, and billing record belongs to exactly one org. That boundary is intentional for procurement, audit, and least-privilege access.
org-workspace.section1Body: Invite teammates with roles that match how you operate. Admins can manage settings and, where applicable, admin surfaces; contributors focus on Studio and Library without inheriting billing controls they do not need.
org-workspace.section2Body:
Library reflects entitlements for the signed-in user's organization. If something is missing, it is usually a subscription or purchase state—not a personal account issue.

Starter plans may see fewer titles; upgrading the org unlocks more catalog content when available.
org-workspace.section3Body: Toss Payments PoC and future gateways attach to the organization so finance has a single invoice trail. Personal accounts exist for sign-in, but purchase and download rights are org-scoped.

security.metaDescription: Supabase Auth, RLS, tenant isolation, and deployment options your security team can align with. Deeper reviews under NDA for enterprise buyers.
security.title: Security & compliance
security.lead: Elevate is built on Supabase with row-level security policies that keep tenant data apart. We do not claim certifications we have not earned—see our Security and Compliance pages for posture and roadmap.
security.section1Body:
Users authenticate via Supabase Auth. Application data reads and writes use policies that require membership in the correct organization.

Service role keys are server-only and never ship to the browser.
security.section2Body:
We target Next.js deployments your team can run on Vercel or compatible hosts. Enterprise customers can request architecture review, DPA, and deeper diligence under NDA.

Operational logging and audit trails are evolving in the product—see the admin audit log where enabled.
security.section3Body: For policy language and legal terms, see the Security and Compliance marketing pages and Privacy Policy. This module summarizes engineering intent, not a substitute for your legal review.

Solutions.title: Solutions
Solutions.description: Event and travel programs generate thousands of comms—speaker briefs, sponsor copy, attendee emails, and exhibitor kits. Elevate helps MICE teams standardize and improve that language with model-aware prompts, org-scoped drafts, and Library-backed assets.

conferences.title: Conferences
conferences.desc: Multi-track programs and speaker/sponsor comms at scale.

exhibitions.title: Exhibitions
exhibitions.desc: Exhibitor kits, floor campaigns, and lead-gen copy consistency.

corporate-meetings.title: Corporate meetings
corporate-meetings.desc: Exec summaries, hybrid runbooks, internal AI policy alignment.

conferences.metaDescription: Improve prompt libraries for speaker briefs, sponsor tiers, and attendee journeys—scoped to your organization.
conferences.title: Conferences
conferences.lead: Large programs mean repeated comms: session descriptions, speaker briefs, sponsor deliverables, and attendee journeys. Elevate helps you build reusable prompt patterns and improve them against the models your team actually uses.
conferences.section1Body:
Use Prompt Studio to tighten instructions for on-brand tone, clarity, and model alignment. When marketing attaches catalog assets, Library makes downloads entitlement-aware—so field teams and agencies pull from the same source of truth.

This is not a replacement for your registration or abstract system; it is the quality layer on top of language and AI-assisted drafts.
conferences.section2Body:
Fewer one-off rewrites, fewer off-brand variants, faster review cycles when teams share org-scoped drafts.

Roles and billing stay tied to the organization so procurement can audit who had access to what.
conferences.section3Body: Join the waitlist for Prompt Studio beta, or open Billing when checkout is enabled to unlock catalog content. Contact sales if you need enterprise rollout and security review.

exhibitions.metaDescription: Consistent exhibitor comms, booth kits, and campaign copy—improved with model-aware prompts and org-scoped drafts.
exhibitions.title: Exhibitions
exhibitions.lead: Exhibitions depend on tight coordination between exhibitors, agencies, and floor teams. Elevate helps you standardize prompt templates for kits, campaigns, and lead follow-ups so tone and claims stay consistent across hundreds of touchpoints.
exhibitions.section1Body:
Prompt Studio surfaces structured improvements so teams do not ship contradictory instructions to models or contractors.

Pair with Library when downloadable guides and templates are part of your commercial program.
exhibitions.section2Body:
Everything stays inside the organization tenant. That matters when sponsors and exhibitors expect confidentiality around unreleased messaging.

Audit and admin tooling continues to mature—see the product changelog for what is live.
exhibitions.section3Body: Browse the catalog for packaged guides, or talk to sales about multi-org programs and pilots.

incentive-travel.metaDescription: Narratives and comms for incentive programs—with structured prompt improvement and org-scoped drafts.
incentive-travel.title: Incentive travel
incentive-travel.lead: Incentive programs require polished narratives, itinerary language, and sensitive attendee comms. Elevate helps teams iterate on prompts with clear model targets and reviewable structure before messages reach VIPs.
incentive-travel.section1Body:
Model-aware prompts reduce the risk of off-tone or off-policy copy when programs span multiple regions.

Drafts remain scoped to your organization so partner agencies and internal teams can collaborate without exposing content publicly.
incentive-travel.section2Body:
When guides are part of the reward package, Library entitlements align downloads with what the org purchased.

Catalog and billing are designed to sit alongside Prompt Studio, not compete with it.
incentive-travel.section3Body: For bespoke programs or compliance-heavy rollouts, contact sales and we will align on review and deployment expectations.

corporate-meetings.metaDescription: Exec summaries, hybrid runbooks, and internal AI policy alignment—improved with Prompt Studio and org-scoped governance.
corporate-meetings.title: Corporate meetings
corporate-meetings.lead: Corporate meetings teams juggle internal comms, executive summaries, and hybrid logistics. Elevate gives you a repeatable prompt layer so leadership updates, FAQs, and policy explanations stay consistent as models and regulations change.
corporate-meetings.section1Body:
Prompt Studio helps teams converge on approved phrasing and structure before content is broadcast to Slack, email, or intranet.

Org workspace ensures the right roles can edit drafts and approve changes.
corporate-meetings.section2Body:
Supabase Auth and RLS underpin tenant isolation. For enterprise buyers, deeper security and compliance materials are available under NDA.

See Security and Compliance pages for statements of direction.
corporate-meetings.section3Body: Start with the waitlist for Prompt Studio beta; add catalog entitlements when you need downloadable playbooks. We will meet you where your procurement process is.

adminLemonWebhook.title: Lemon Squeezy webhook test
adminLemonWebhook.intro: Use this page when testing Lemon Squeezy → Elevate: match catalog rows, webhook URL, and optional variant mapping. Test mode uses Stripe test cards (e.g. 4242 4242 4242 4242).
adminLemonWebhook.localWebhookWarning: NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL points to localhost — Lemon cannot POST webhooks here. Register the webhook URL on your deployed host (e.g. https://elevate.ai.kr/api/webhooks/lemonsqueezy) and verify entitlements there or via Supabase.
adminLemonWebhook.linkCatalog: Open Library catalog to create or edit content_products
adminLemonWebhook.noOrg: No organization on your profile. Finish onboarding first.
adminLemonWebhook.profileEmailHint: Use this email at Lemon checkout so the webhook can resolve your org (unless you pass organization_id in custom_data).
adminLemonWebhook.emptyCatalog: No catalog rows yet. Add one from Library catalog.
adminLemonWebhook.variantEnvIntro: On production (e.g. Vercel), set LEMON_SQUEEZY_VARIANT_TO_CONTENT_SLUG to a JSON object mapping Lemon variant ID (string key) to catalog slug. Use when Share links cannot pass custom_data.
adminLemonWebhook.variantEnvPlaceholder: Enter a variant ID and pick a slug to generate the env line.
adminLemonWebhook.webhookUrlHint: Lemon → Settings → Webhooks. Signing secret must match LEMON_SQUEEZY_WEBHOOK_SECRET on the server that receives this URL.
adminLemonWebhook.verifyLine1: Supabase: rows in lemon_squeezy_processed_orders and organization_content_entitlements.
adminLemonWebhook.verifyLine2: Lemon test mode: use Stripe test card 4242 4242 4242 4242.
adminLemonWebhook.verifyLine3: Production host (e.g. elevate.ai.kr): deploy LEMON_SQUEEZY_WEBHOOK_SECRET and optional LEMON_SQUEEZY_VARIANT_TO_CONTENT_SLUG.
adminLemonWebhook.customDataIntro: If Lemon checkout supports custom_data (API/Overlay), paste the JSON from the table. Plain Share links often cannot append custom_data—use variant mapping + matching profile email instead.
adminLemonWebhook.footerNote: Secrets stay in environment variables only; this page never shows LEMON_SQUEEZY_WEBHOOK_SECRET.

adminContent.title: Library catalog
adminContent.intro: Upload a PDF, EPUB, or ZIP. Files are stored in Supabase Storage and linked to the catalog; entitled users download from Library.
adminContent.lemonBlurb: Lemon Squeezy: link each catalog row to a variant in your Lemon store (API keys on the server). Billing then opens checkout with organization and product data embedded—no per-product env JSON.
adminContent.createIntro: Creating an item requires uploading a file. To change title, price, slug, or Lemon settings only, choose Edit on a row.
adminContent.empty: No catalog rows yet. Upload a file below.
adminContent.deleteConfirm: Delete “{title}”? This removes the storage file, Lemon link, and library entitlements for this product.
adminContent.slugEditHint: Must stay unique. Changing the slug updates links that use it (e.g. /dashboard/billing?product=…).
adminContent.activeLabel: Active (shown in Library when customers are entitled)
adminContent.replaceFileHint: Leave empty to keep the current file. Uploading stores a new object and deletes the previous one.
adminContent.lemonInlineHint: Enter a variant ID or use Browse. The link is saved when you choose Save changes (same as the rest of this form).
adminContent.slugHint: Must be unique across the catalog (enforced in the database). Slugs normalize to lowercase; hyphens separate words.
adminContent.replaceExisting: Replace the existing catalog row that uses this slug (required when updating an item).
adminContent.priceKrwLemonHint: Lemon Squeezy checkout requires at least {minKrw} KRW for this currency (processor minimum).
adminContent.fileHint: PDF, EPUB, or ZIP. Max 120 MB.
adminContent.successReplaced: Existing row replaced for this slug.

errors.file_type: Only PDF, EPUB, or ZIP files are allowed.

errors.slug_taken: This slug is already in use. Enable the replace option below or choose another slug.

audit.intro: Changes made through the app (settings, invitations, payments, etc.) are recorded here for your organization.

productions.listSubtitle: Track Shorts and other deliverables—prompts, tool labels, and links in one place. Start by pasting from Runway, ChatGPT, and other tools; when your org connects provider APIs (opt-in), the same episode record can drive automated runs. Saved public URLs open in a new tab.
productions.hubSubtitle: Pick a project for brand voice, then create and ship episodes from one queue.
productions.hubHelpBody: Track Shorts and other deliverables—prompts, tool labels, and links in one place. Start by pasting from Runway, ChatGPT, and other tools; when your org connects provider APIs (opt-in), the same episode record can drive automated runs. Saved public URLs open in a new tab.
productions.listEmptyShort: No episodes match this view. Create an episode to get started.
productions.hubScopeBannerUnassigned: Showing only episodes not linked to a project. Link one from episode details, or choose a project with the selector above.
productions.hubScopeBannerProject: Showing episodes for “{name}” only. Edit the brand guide with Settings next to the Episodes heading.
productions.hubEmptyStateBody: Create a new episode to stack prompts, scripts, and links in one place.
productions.hubQueueProjectSettingsAria: Edit settings for the project scoped to this queue
productions.listEmpty: No episodes yet. Create one to stack prompts and links. Provider integrations (API keys in org settings, connected orgs only) will extend this flow with automation—without replacing manual capture.
productions.demoSeedBody: Loads three episodes for an “AI Shorts + monetization” team: draft → ready → published, with prompts, scripts, and links as artifacts. Episode titles start with “[Demo]”. Server env ENABLE_STUDIO_DEMO_SEED=true required.
productions.projectsListSubtitle: Manage brands, channels, or client projects. Each project scopes episodes, AI persona, and YouTube tokens.
productions.projectsListEmpty: No projects yet. Create one to group episodes by brand or channel.
productions.projectsFormDescriptionPlaceholder: Short description of this project's purpose
productions.projectsFormTonePresetsLabel: Quick tone (appends English cues for the model)
productions.projectsFormBrandGuidePlaceholder: Tone, style, restrictions, target audience. This text is injected into every draft generation prompt.
productions.projectsFormBrandGuideHint: The AI will follow this guide when generating scripts for episodes in this project.
productions.projectsDeleteConfirm: Delete this project? Episodes will be unlinked but not deleted.
productions.integrationsIntro: Save API keys for your organization to power Studio features (drafts, tests, and connected tools). Keys are encrypted at rest. Connection tests only run when your deployment allows server-side provider calls.
productions.integrationsNoOrganization: Join or create an organization to manage integrations.
productions.integrationsEncryptionOff: The server is missing STUDIO_INTEGRATIONS_ENCRYPTION_KEY. Saving keys is disabled until it is set.
productions.integrationsServerCallsOff: STUDIO_INTEGRATIONS_ENABLED is not true — Test connection is disabled; saving still stores an encrypted key for later.
productions.integrationsReadOnlyEditors: You can view status, but only admins, organizers, or coordinators can change keys.
productions.integrationsKeySavedStatus: A key is saved for this organization.
productions.integrationsNeverVerified: Not verified with this provider yet.
productions.integrationsRevealSensitiveHint: Only admins, organizers, and coordinators can reveal keys. Treat this like production secrets—avoid screen shares and public logs.
productions.integrationsKeyPlaceholderStored: Paste a new key to replace the saved one, or click Show saved key to load it here.
productions.integrationsRunConnectionTestHint: Use “Test connection” below to confirm this key works with the provider.
productions.integrationsUnverifiedNeedServerFlag: To run the test: set STUDIO_INTEGRATIONS_ENABLED=true in your environment, restart the dev server, scroll to Test connection below, and submit.
productions.integrationsBillingCreditNote: Most providers do not expose remaining credits or usage via a simple API call from this app. Open your provider’s billing or usage console to check balance.
productions.integrationsYoutubeDataUploadHint: To upload videos to YouTube, connect your channel in Distribution channels with Google OAuth. This tab only stores the Data API key for search and metadata.
productions.channelsYoutubeOAuthIntro: Connect with Google OAuth to choose which channel receives uploads. Configure the YouTube Data API key for search and metadata separately under Tools → Integrations → YouTube.
productions.integrationsYoutubeOAuthDisconnectedLead: No channel linked yet. Connect with Google to choose the upload destination for the pipeline.
productions.integrationsYoutubeOAuthNotConfigured: YouTube OAuth is not configured on the server. Set YOUTUBE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID, YOUTUBE_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET, and YOUTUBE_OAUTH_REDIRECT_URI (must match the authorized redirect URI in Google Cloud).

openai.title: OpenAI
openai.intro: API key for OpenAI (Chat Completions / Responses, etc.). Stored encrypted at rest. Use Test connection only when server outbound calls are enabled.
openai.keySourceHint: Sign in to OpenAI → API keys → Create new secret key (or copy an existing one).

anthropic.title: Anthropic (Claude)
anthropic.intro: API key for Anthropic’s Claude API. Stored encrypted at rest. Test connection calls the list-models endpoint; no message generation.
anthropic.keySourceHint: Sign in to Anthropic Console → API keys → Create key (or copy an existing one).

google_gemini.title: Google Gemini
google_gemini.intro: API key from Google AI Studio / Gemini API. Test calls the list-models endpoint; no generation.
google_gemini.keySourceHint: Open Google AI Studio and create an API key (usable for Gemini API requests).

runway.title: Runway
runway.intro: API secret from dev.runwayml.com (Bearer token). Connection test calls GET /v1/organization (org usage tier / credits), same as the official SDK.
runway.keySourceHint: Sign in to the Runway developer portal → your organization → API Keys → create a key.

youtube_data.title: YouTube Data API
youtube_data.intro: Google API key with YouTube Data API v3 enabled (search and metadata). Uploads use Google OAuth under Distribution channels; the API key alone cannot upload to your channel.
youtube_data.keySourceHint: In Google Cloud: pick a project → enable YouTube Data API v3 → APIs & Credentials → Create credentials → API key. Restrict the key for production.
youtube_data.keySourceSecondaryLabel: Google Cloud — Enable YouTube Data API v3

elevenlabs.title: ElevenLabs
elevenlabs.intro: API key for ElevenLabs Text-to-Speech. Stored encrypted at rest. Test connection verifies the key against the user endpoint.
elevenlabs.keySourceHint: Sign in to ElevenLabs → Profile + API key → copy your API key.

productions.channelsPageSubtitle: Save YouTube (or other) channel page URLs here so episodes can open them in one click (HTTPS only). Connect Google OAuth below to enable uploads to your YouTube channel.
productions.channelsAddSubtitle: Give it a label and paste the channel page URL (e.g. youtube.com/@handle).
productions.channelsListEmpty: No channels yet. Add one above.
productions.channelsDeleteConfirm: Remove this channel? Episodes that pointed here will clear the channel link.
productions.shortsPlanSubtitle: Pick interest, format, and channel—when a format is selected, script and hook drafts are added automatically.
productions.shortsTemplateHint: Choosing a format aligns the niche and seeds script + hook artifacts on create.
productions.shortsTopicPlaceholder: e.g. the name of that Joseon-era coin
productions.shortsTopicHint: Substitutes into the topic placeholder in the format template.
productions.shortsChannelHint: Managed under Channels. Add URLs there first.
productions.optionalChannelSubtitle: Link this episode to a saved channel (long-form YouTube, X, Reels, TikTok). Create channels under Channels if needed.
productions.newSubtitle: Add a title, channel, and optional Shorts plan. Paste-based workflow today; the same structure is meant to layer API-driven steps once integrations are enabled.
productions.draftPanelSubtitle: Generate a first pass with your org’s OpenAI or Anthropic key (Integrations), edit freely, or ask the model to refine. Runway upload and YouTube publish-from-app are roadmap items.
productions.draftSectionDescription: Copy for the video itself—distinct from the working title above. Generate with AI, refine, then save when you want this version on record.
productions.draftPanelReadOnly: Only admins, organizers, and coordinators can generate or edit drafts here.
productions.draftLlmSetupDescription: Provider and model determine API pricing and behavior. Switching provider changes which models you can pick.
productions.draftLlmKeysRequiredHint: Add an OpenAI or Anthropic API key under Studio integrations to generate drafts with AI.
productions.draftLlmPricingFootnote: Amounts shown are approximate list prices (USD per 1M tokens). Your invoice may differ due to caching, contracts, or promotions.
productions.draftGenerateModeHint: Develop: uses the fields below plus episode/channel context. Fresh: treats your direction as the main topic—does not carry over the current hook/title/script and down-ranks conflicting title/notes/niche when they disagree with your direction.
productions.draftTemplateHint: Adds structure and tone hints to the AI prompt. Your direction below still wins if they conflict.
productions.draftTemplateManageIntro: These apply to your organization. The bias text is merged into the AI prompt (same as built-in templates).
productions.draftTemplateManageBiasHint: Paste a full style guide, sample hooks, dos and don’ts, or glossary—English usually works best for model instructions. This field can be long.
productions.draftTemplateManageEmpty: No custom templates yet. Add one below.
productions.draftTemplateManageAddPausedHint: Save or cancel editing above to add another template here.
productions.draftTemplateManageDeleteConfirm: Delete this template? Episodes using it will fall back to the default built-in template until you pick another.
productions.draftTemplateManageBiasPlaceholder: Instructions for tone, structure, pacing, CTA…
productions.draftBriefingPlaceholder: e.g. Target audience, channel voice, must-include facts, what to avoid…
productions.draftBriefingHint: Highest priority for topic and tone when it conflicts with saved episode context or the template. The model cannot fetch URLs—paste lyrics, a transcript, or a short summary if you want content based on a YouTube link.
productions.draftStickyContextDescription: Reused every time you generate for this episode unless your direction below overrides it.
productions.draftStickyContextPlaceholder: e.g. Audience, banned words, recurring bits, reference notes…
productions.draftStickyContextHint: Stored on this episode. Applies after the style template and before “Direction for this generation only”. Save when you want it to persist across sessions.
productions.draftBrandGuideStrip: Your project brand guide is included in the AI prompt for this step.
productions.draftDialogTablistAria: Draft workflow: generate, refine, or edit
productions.draftRefinePlaceholder: e.g. Shorten the hook and make the tone more playful.
productions.draftRunwaySuccess: Runway finished. The output link was added to this episode’s artifacts.
productions.draftRunwayDisabledHint: Connect a Runway API key and enable server integrations to render from here.
productions.draftTtsSuccess: TTS audio generated and saved as artifact.
productions.draftTtsDisabledHint: Add your ElevenLabs API key under Integrations (Studio).
productions.draftSubtitleDisabledHint: Generate TTS audio first, then generate subtitles.
productions.draftSceneRenderSuccess: Scene clips generated. Check artifacts for results.
productions.draftAssembleDisabledHint: Generate scene clips first to assemble.
productions.draftAssembleQueued: Video assembly queued. This may take a few minutes.
productions.draftAssembleProcessingHint: Assembly in progress on the worker…
productions.draftYoutubeDisabledHint: Assemble a video first, then upload to YouTube.
productions.pipelineYoutubeNotConnected: Connect a YouTube channel under Integrations to upload.
productions.pipelineYoutubePreviewSubtitle: Confirm title, description, thumbnail, and visibility before uploading.
productions.pipelineYoutubeOAuthExplain: Uploads go to the channel you authorized in Studio. The linked episode channel is for planning unless it is the same account.
productions.pipelineYoutubeNoThumbnail: No thumbnail artifact — you can still upload; set a custom thumbnail in YouTube Studio after upload if needed.
productions.pipelineYoutubePreviewReadOnlyHint: Read-only preview. Use “Upload” on the card to edit and submit.
productions.pipelineYoutubeCardAdvancedHint: The OAuth-connected channel is the real upload target. Reconnect under Integrations if needed.
productions.pipelineProduceVoiceIdHintCustom: Paste an ElevenLabs voice ID from your library. Leave preset on Female or Male if you do not need a custom voice.
productions.pipelineProduceLanguageHint: Defaults to your dashboard language. Multilingual models use this as language_code.
productions.pipelineProduceTtsStyleHint: Stronger expressiveness on supported models. Leave empty to use the provider default.
productions.pipelineProduceTargetSceneCountHint: When not using custom JSON, roughly how many scenes to split the script into (heuristic path only).
productions.pipelineProduceBgMusicVolumeHint: Relative to narration when a music URL is set.
productions.pipelineProduceScenesJsonHint: Leave empty to auto-split the script. Paste a JSON array to override scene prompts and durations.
productions.pipelinePrefsAutoSaveHint: Advanced options auto-save shortly after you stop editing.
productions.pipelineProduceScenesJsonPlaceholder: Example: JSON array of objects with keys narration, visual_prompt, duration_seconds (see monospace sample in the field).
productions.pipelineScenePlanLlmHint: Uses your script and project brand guide when set. Output fills the JSON field below.
productions.pipelineScenePlanLlmSuccess: Scene plan inserted into the JSON field.
productions.pipelineScenePlanLlmNeedScript: Save script text in the Draft step first.
productions.pipelineSceneBudgetSoftWarning: Planned total duration is {seconds}s (high). Proceed if intentional.
productions.pipelineSceneBrandGuideOn: Project brand guide will be merged into Runway visual prompts.
productions.pipelineSceneEstimatedCreditsDisclaimer: Illustrative only — actual usage and billing are shown in your Runway account.
productions.pipelineScenePlanDialogDescription: Per-scene narration, visuals, and estimated credits before you render.
productions.pipelineSceneFormatDerivedHint: Format is derived from this episode’s distribution label and linked Studio channel.
productions.pipelineSceneBudgetThresholds: Duration budget (same as server): soft warning when total planned time is above {warnSeconds}s; render is blocked above {maxSeconds}s.
productions.pipelineSceneRunwayVideoModelHint: Used for each scene clip when you run Scene render. Veo models use HD aspect presets; duration follows your scene plan (Veo 3 / 3.1 use 4, 6, or 8 seconds).
productions.pipelineSceneRunwayVisualSuffixHint: Appended to every scene’s Runway prompt after the brand guide merge (optional).
productions.pipelineSceneRunwayVisualSuffixPlacehold: e.g. cinematic lighting, slow dolly, no text overlays

productions.pipelineProduceSubtitleAdvancedHint: With timed TTS segments, subtitles are built from timestamps (no Whisper). Otherwise OpenAI Whisper is used (requires an OpenAI key).
productions.pipelineModalTtsDescription: Latest generated audio and script preview.
productions.pipelineAssemblyVideoError: Could not load the video ({detail}). Try refreshing the page or assembling again.
productions.draftPreprodSectionSubtitle: Before TTS and video: timed script lines, title/description copy for your destination, and a thumbnail image prompt.
productions.draftPreprodDraftHint: Use the Draft step on this tab — Run opens the editor to save hook, title, and script.
productions.pipelineDraftDialogDescription: Changes here update the episode draft used by the next pipeline steps.
productions.pipelineDraftCloseConfirmDescription: You have edits that are not saved to the server yet.
productions.draftPreprodTimedHintNoScript: Save a script first — use the Draft step on the Pipeline tab.
productions.draftPreprodTimedHint: Default: heuristic [mm:ss] lines from paragraphs (pacing from length). Advanced: pick a chat model and optional instructions for LLM-timed segments.
productions.draftPreprodPackagingHintNoScript: Save a script first — use the Draft step on the Pipeline tab.
productions.draftPreprodPackagingHintNoLlm: Add an OpenAI or Anthropic API key under Integrations.
productions.draftPreprodPackagingHint: LLM drafts a ≤60-char title, description, and a policy-compliant thumbnail image prompt. Generate the image in the next step.
productions.pipelineModalThumbnailNote: Generated from your packaging draft’s thumbnail prompt (OpenAI Images).
productions.draftThumbnailImageHint: Generates a 1792×1024 HD image (DALL-E 3) with YouTube-compliant guardrails. Text overlay is separate.
productions.draftThumbnailImageHintNoOpenAi: Add an OpenAI API key under Integrations to generate images.
productions.draftThumbnailImageHintNoPackaging: Run packaging first so a thumbnail prompt exists.
productions.draftThumbnailImageHintNoPrompt: Packaging has no thumbnail prompt yet — redo packaging or edit the draft.
productions.draftTtsNeedScriptHint: Save hook, title, and script in the Pipeline tab first (Draft step).
productions.draftPipelineSubtitle: AI-assisted steps: voice, visuals, assembly, upload.
productions.pipelineNextNeedDraft: Save hook, title, and script in the Pipeline tab first.
productions.pipelineInputSourcesEmpty: No reference sources yet. Add links, transcripts, or notes under Sources — they stay in sync here.
productions.pipelineStepCustomInstructionsPlaceholde: e.g. Warmer tone, tighter hook, avoid jargon…
productions.pipelinePhasePrepareSubtitle: Save hook, title, and script draft first (Pipeline tab), then run timeline script → packaging copy → thumbnail prompt → thumbnail image in order. Use the draft card for model & pre-instructions, then Run / View to open the editor.
productions.pipelinePhaseProduceSubtitle: Follow this order: TTS → subtitles → scene clips → assemble → YouTube.
productions.referenceSubtitle: Add YouTube audio, web articles, pasted text, or your own notes — then generate a script.
productions.referenceWebUrlHint: We fetch the public page (title, summary, and main text when possible). YouTube links belong in the YouTube tab.
productions.referenceNoteHint: Your interpretation, bullet summary, or commentary. Combined with other sources when you generate a script.
productions.referenceNotePlaceholder: Write your notes, interpretation, or a manual summary of external content…
productions.referenceDeleteConfirm: Remove this reference from the episode?
productions.referenceTextPlaceholder: Paste book summary, article text, lecture notes...
productions.referenceNoSources: Add at least one reference source first.
productions.draftCompareSubtitle: New text is already saved. Use in editor copies it into the fields below. Revert restores your previous version on the server.
productions.draftHistorySubtitle: Each row is a saved snapshot (AI or manual). Load one into the editor, then use Save draft if you want to keep working from it.
productions.draftHistoryEmpty: No snapshots yet. Generate a draft or save to build history.
productions.episodeProjectHint: Optional. Group this episode under a brand or channel project, or leave unassigned.
productions.distributionHint: Optional. e.g. stealth channel vs official.
productions.distributionSelectHint: Pick where this piece ships first—the link field below updates with context for that surface.
productions.publishUrlHint: Optional. YouTube or other public link.
productions.publishUrlHintGeneric: HTTPS link to the public page or post when it exists—paste from the browser bar.
productions.publishUrlHintYoutubeShorts: Paste the public Shorts or watch URL (youtube.com/shorts/… or watch?v=…).
productions.publishUrlHintYoutubeLong: Paste the public video URL once the long-form is live.
productions.publishUrlHintInstagram: Use the share link to the Reel or feed post (instagram.com/reel/… or /p/…).
productions.publishUrlHintTiktok: Paste the tiktok.com/… link to the published video.
productions.publishUrlHintLinkedin: Paste the permalink to the LinkedIn post or article.
productions.publishUrlHintX: Paste the x.com or twitter.com status URL.
productions.publishUrlHintWebsite: Landing page, blog post, or embed page—whatever you consider canonical.
productions.publishUrlHintOther: Any HTTPS URL where this deliverable lives publicly.
productions.workbenchTabsLead: Glance: status and step-grouped artifacts. Episode: sources, pipeline, settings, and the full artifact list below.
productions.episodeWorkspaceSubtitleV2: Work left to right: gather sources, run the pipeline, then edit settings (metadata). Glance summarizes by phase; Episode holds pipeline, settings, and the artifact editor.
productions.episodePanelBodyReferences: Add links, transcripts, and notes. They are stored as reference artifacts and feed the script step.
productions.episodePanelBodyProduce: Pre-production (timed lines, packaging copy), then speech, visuals, assembly, and upload. Each run saves artifacts listed under Produce in Overview.
productions.episodePanelBodyEpisode: Working title, status, publication target, project, and internal notes—operator-facing fields separate from the creative tabs.
productions.producePanelLead: Steps create or update artifacts (see the list at the bottom of this tab). Prefer running in order when dependencies apply.
productions.scenesOverviewDeck: Plan rows come from your saved scene plan; each clip is a scene_clip artifact linked by index. Use the Scene render step below to edit the plan or generate clips.
productions.scenesOverviewEmptyHint: Write a script, open the Scene render step in this pipeline, then save or generate a scene plan.
productions.artifactsSceneClipsHiddenHint: Scene clips are grouped in Scenes at the top of this tab.
productions.artifactsSceneClipsHiddenOnlyHint: Only scene clips are hidden—use “Show scene clips in list” above to see them here.
productions.atAGlanceEmpty: Nothing to show yet—add sources or a script, or run a production step. Cards group by phase: input, draft, then produce.
productions.artifactsDeckSubtitle: Prompts, links, and snippets in story order (top = first step). Edit an artifact to change its order number.
productions.episodeWorkspaceSubtitle: One flow: where it ships, your notes, then hook, title, and script for this content.
productions.episodeMetaDescription: Working title, status, channel, and notes—the context the AI prompt uses together with your draft direction.
productions.deleteEpisodeConfirm: Delete this episode and all its artifacts?
productions.helpBody: v1 does not call external services directly—paste prompts, settings, and URLs from Runway, ChatGPT, Gemini, and others into artifacts. Short role names keep the list scannable. Roadmap: organizations that store provider API keys will be able to run generations and uploads from the same episode shell (connected orgs only); today remains copy-and-paste.
productions.helpRunbook: Manual Runway Shorts: see docs/RUNWAY_SHORTS_RUNBOOK.md and docs/RUNWAY_SCENE_BUILDER_STEP2.md in this repository.
productions.artifactRoleHint: Suggested: script · prompt · settings · render_output · compliance_note · other. Short names scan faster in the list.
productions.artifactSortHint: Lower numbers appear first. Use this to match shot order (e.g. 0, 1, 2…).

studio.intro: Model-aware prompt analysis and reviewable improvements are shipping here. This page is the home for the killer loop—try the Library for e-books and guides today, and watch this space as we wire LLM-backed flows.
studio.bullet1: Choose a target model and paste a prompt.
studio.bullet2: Get structured suggestions (full diff + accept flows on the roadmap).
studio.bullet3: Keep work inside your org with Library and billing.
studio.note: API contract for improvements is defined in docs/adr/ADR-002-prompt-studio-mvp.md. Until enabled, requests return a clear not-ready response.

sendToProductions.scratchHint: Paste or refine a prompt, then send it to Productions. It becomes episode notes (new episode) or a new artifact (existing episode). Nothing leaves your browser until you continue.
sendToProductions.dialogHint: New episode: text goes into Notes on the create form. Existing episode: we prefill the add-artifact box—save when ready.
sendToProductions.optionNewDesc: Open the create form with this text in Notes.
sendToProductions.optionExistingDesc: Jump to an episode and prefill a new artifact.
sendToProductions.noEpisodes: No episodes yet—create one from Productions first.

library.subtitle: Entitled titles appear here. Access can depend on your organization’s subscription (Professional / Enterprise) and on individual purchases—open Billing to upgrade or unlock items.
library.subscriptionBanner: Your organization is on the Starter plan. Many library assets are included with a paid organization subscription; if expected titles are missing or stay locked, you may need to upgrade—not only a catalog or setup issue.
library.emptyStarterNote: If this page stays empty or items remain locked, your organization may not have an active subscription yet, or the catalog may have no items. You can still unlock individual titles from Billing when checkout is available.
library.empty: Your library is empty. There are no catalog items yet and no purchases for your organization. When content is available and purchased, it will appear here.
library.detailCheckoutSuccessPendingBody: Your payment is in. Access usually appears within a minute—you don’t need to pay again. If this page still looks locked, refresh the Library or open this title again.
library.detailCheckoutSuccessUnlockedBody: This title is already available for your organization.
library.checkoutErrorGeneric: We could not open the payment page. Try again, or use Billing for troubleshooting.
library.checkoutErrorNotLinked: This title isn’t ready for checkout yet. Ask your organization administrator to finish catalog setup.
library.checkoutErrorApiNotConfigured: Checkout isn’t available yet. Ask your organization administrator for help.
library.checkoutErrorCheckoutFailed: We couldn’t open the payment page. Try again in a moment.
library.checkoutErrorPriceLow: This title’s price is too low for online checkout. An administrator may need to update it in the catalog.
library.checkoutErrorUnknownProduct: This catalog item is missing or inactive.
library.readerEmpty: No in-app content is available for this title yet. If you believe this is a mistake, contact support.
library.readerUsageNotice: Licensed for use in this workspace. Web-only titles do not offer a file download; content may still be copied or captured from the browser like any web page.
